"""Browser authentication-state boundary."""

from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import hashlib
import hmac
import time


def create_browser_auth_state(user_id: str, secret: str) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Build a signed, HTTP-only cookie payload representing login state.

    The signed token never leaves the cookie for browser JavaScript, so no
    bearer credential (e.g. a JWT) is exposed to client-side storage.
    """
    issued_at = str(int(time.time()))
    payload = f"{user_id}:{issued_at}"
    signature = hmac.new(
        secret.encode("utf-8"), payload.encode("utf-8"), hashlib.sha256
    ).hexdigest()
    token = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(f"{payload}:{signature}".encode("utf-8")).decode("ascii")

    return {
        "cookie_name": "auth_state",
        "value": token,
        "http_only": True,
        "secure": True,
        "same_site": "Strict",
    }
